title: BazaarVirtualStoreCatalog
description: JSON Schema validating the Bazaar Republic Daily Marketplace Virtual Store Catalog configuration structure, designed for BigInt 7-decimal currency integrity under Schema v2.7.2 constraints.

catalogVersion.description: SemVer release tracking version of the marketplace store catalog structure.

comment.description: General administrative description or economic notes on this catalog version.

categories.description: List of top-level structural business directories within the E-Network.

id.description: Immutable uppercase category identifier code used for routing queries.

name.description: Human-readable label shown to Pioneers on viewport docks.

stalls.description: Active registered competing service stalls under this specific catalog sector.

providerUid.description: The unique, verified cryptographic uid of the host Pioneer running this node.

businessName.description: Sovereign trademark/brand label of the physical stall.

strategy.description: Microeconomic placement model determining listing tier rules.

description.description: Brief informational subtitle explaining the merchant's core local specialization.

sectorLocation.description: Assigned geographical sector and country country-code parity target.

baseFeePi.description: The administrative minimum baseline settlement fee of this stall denominated in raw Pi.

rating.description: Average reputation rating calculated from completed dispute resolutions and transaction history.

inventory.description: Available stock of commodities currently locked in off-chain state channel channels.

id.description: Uniquely identifiers code matching item collection tracking structures.

name.description: Human-readable item label shown on the S23 Ultra storefront cards.

pricePi.description: The exact decimal string representation of the price in Pi (e.g. '0.1500000').

priceSubunits.description: Price represented in BigInt 7-decimal subunits (Stroops) to eliminate floating-point calculation drift (e.g. '1500000').

description.description: A short informational summary details of the item's specifications or quantities.
